track.title: Afshari: Daramad V
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: Daramads I, II, V vote E, Daramads III, IV, VI, VII vote B, the Forud votes F#. Vote kept.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#4 and dwells most on F# in Daramad V. The line peaks at G#4 (425.6 Hz) at 0:02.6. It closes on B3, not the tonic (F#4 → Fk4 → F#4 → E4 → E4 → B3).
